planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting. Tripletex auto-generates VAT and credit postings.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.

payload.headline: Supplier created but invoice registration failed 5/6 checks, likely wrong API endpoint or structure
what_went_wrong: Only 1/6 checks passed (supplier creation), suggesting the voucher-based approach is wrong — Tripletex likely expects POST /invoice/supplier or similar dedicated supplier invoice endpoint, not /ledger/voucher.
First voucher POST failed with balance error ('postings don't sum to zero'), wasting a call and indicating the single-posting approach was incorrect.
The vendor invoice number, due date, and supplier linkage may not be recognized by the scoring system when registered as a generic voucher rather than a proper supplier invoice object.

Account 6300 may be 'Leie lokale' (rent) rather than a network services account — but more critically, the invoice structure (date, due date, invoice number) likely needs the /invoice/supplier endpoint to be scored correctly.
what_worked: Supplier Greenfield Ltd was successfully created with correct org number, address, and bank account (Check 1 passed).
Parallel API calls for supplier creation and account lookup were efficient.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /invoice/supplier (or equivalent Tripletex supplier invoice endpoint) instead of /ledger/voucher — this likely captures invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate, and supplier as first-class fields that the scorer checks.

Verify the correct endpoint for supplier invoices: check if Tripletex has /purchaseOrder or /invoice/supplier with fields like invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate, amountExcludingVat, amountIncludingVat, and vatAmount.

If voucher is the only option, ensure vendorInvoiceNumber, due date (paymentDueDate), and supplier are set at the voucher level (not just posting level) and confirm the VAT type ID for 25% input VAT is correct.
unnecessary_calls: First POST /ledger/voucher with single debit posting — failed predictably; should have included AP credit posting from the start.
Second GET /ledger/account for account 2400 — could have been fetched in the initial parallel batch alongside account 6300.
